{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Sex-worker-led movements worldwide are engaged in a struggle to win basic human and labor rights for sex workers.",

"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The removal of carceral threats is a necessary prerequisite for sex workers to swing the power imbalance of discriminatory societal/corporate policy, police, and state authority back into the hands of sex workers.",

"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The organization committed to remedy harm to the best of its ability at its 2019 National Convention by passing Resolution 53: “Pro-Decriminalization of Sex Work”.",
